name: Actemra
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 2 weeks. Do not use if product was exposed to temperatures above 86F
storage: Must be refrigerated at 36°F to 46°F (2ºC to 8ºC). Do not freeze. Can be stored for up to 2 weeks at or below 86F. Return to refrigerator. Protect from light.
derivation: Up to 86°F for 2 weeks, then return to the refrigerator. Do not use if it went above 86°F.

name: Adalimumab-fkjp
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 14 days
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (77F) for up to 14 days. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 14 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light.

name: Afinitor
excursionNote: Allowance for brief excursions between 59-86F, provided that the average temperature for transit time does not exceed 77F per USP 659.
storage: Tablets should be stored at controlled room temperature (between 68 and 77F). There is an allowance for brief excursions between 59-86F, provided that the average temperature for transit time does not exceed 77F per USP 659. Store in original container to protect from light and moisture. (generic and brand)
derivation: Tablets, controlled room temperature 68-77°F, brief excursions 59-86°F. Not a cold-chain product.

name: Aimovig
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for 7 days, and up to 104°F for 2 days
storage: Store between 36° to 46°F. Protect from light. Do not freeze. If kept at room temperature (77*F), use within 7 days. Stability data shows product is stable up to 2 days up to 104*F). Do NOT return to fridge once removed and brought to room temp
derivation: 77°F for 7 days at room temperature, and up to 104°F for no more than 2 days. The sheet now states the high window as "up to 104°F", so it starts at 77°F rather than 86°F.

name: Amjevita
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 14 days
storage: Store at 36-46F. May be stored at room temperature (77F) for up to 14 days. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 14 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light.

name: Apidra
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Unopened vials and pens should be refrigerated at 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C) until expiration date OR at room temperature (up to 77F) for 28 days. Protect from light. Do not freeze. Opened vials can be stored at either room temperature or in the fridge for 28 days. Opened pens should only be stored at room temperature for 28 days.

name: Avonex
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 7 days
storage: Store at 36—46*F. If refrigeration is unavailable, may store at 77*F or less for up to 7 days. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 77*F. If the product has been exposed to conditions other than recommended, discard the product and do not use Transient exposure to temps as low as 23*F for up to 36 hours had no impact on quality
derivation: The Min Temp cell reads 23°F, from "transient exposure as low as 23°F for up to 36 hours had no impact on quality". That limit is far shorter than the 7-day allowance, so the floor stays 36°F and 23-36°F is kept as a cold band for the card to show.

name: Avsola
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 180 days, and up to 104°F for 30 days
storage: Store unopened vials in fridge at 36°F to 46°F. Protect from light. May also be stored at temperatures up to a maximum of 86°F for a single period of up to 6 months but not exceeding the original expiration date. Upon removal from refrigerated storage, cannot be returned to refrigerated storage.
derivation: Up to 86°F for a single period of 6 months, or up to 104°F for a single period of 30 days. Cannot go back into refrigeration once removed.

name: Basaglar
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 28 days, and up to 104°F for 4 hours
storage: Store at 36—46*F. May store at 86*F or less for up to 28 days before and after opening. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 86*F. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Discard pen 28 days after first use, whether refrigerated or not.
derivation: 86°F for 28 days before and after opening (Storage); up to 104°F for 4 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Cimzia
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 7 days
storage: Store at 36-46F. May be stored at room temperature (77F) for up to 7 days. Discard syringe if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 7 days. Do not return to refrigerator once syringe has reached room temperature. Do not freeze. Discard syringe if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Do not shake.

name: Copaxone
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than one month
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (86F-59F) for up to one month. Discard syringe if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with one month. Do not freeze. Discard syringe if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light.

name: Cosentyx
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 4 days
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (86F) for up to 4 days. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 4 days. May be placed back in the refrigerator ONCE (if 4 days has not passed). Do not remove from the refrigerator again until ready to use or pen expires. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Do not shake.

name: Cyltezo
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 14 days
storage: Store at 36-46F. May be stored at room temperature (77F) for up to 14 days. Discard pen/syringe if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 14 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen/syringe if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light.

name: Darzalex & Darzalex Faspro
excursionNote: Excursions permitted between -4°F to 34°F for up to 9 days cumulative excursions, in no more than 3 excursions (3 days each). No excursion information for temperatures above 46F.
storage: Store vials in a refrigerator at 2ºC to 8ºC (36ºF to 46ºF). Protect from light. Do not freeze. Excursions permitted between -20°C to 1°C (-4°F to 34°F) for up to 9 days cumulative excursions, in no more than 3 excursions (3 days each).

tiers.note: no more than 3 excursions of up to 3 days each

derivation: No excursion data above 46°F, so no warm allowance. Cold excursions of -4 to 34°F are permitted for 9 days cumulative in no more than 3 excursions; kept as a cold band, since the episode limits cannot be checked from a weather record.

name: Dupixent
excursionNote: Excursions up to 86°F (or down to 32°F) for no more than 14 days showed no impact on quality (may return to refrigeration before 14 days)
storage: Store at 36—46*F. If refrigeration is unavailable, may store at 77*F or less for up to 14 days. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 77*F. If the product has been exposed to conditions other than recommended, discard the product and do not use
derivation: Excursions up to 86°F or down to 32°F for no more than 14 days showed no impact on quality, and it may go back in the fridge within the 14 days. The 32°F floor has the same 14-day limit as the main allowance, so it is used as the floor.

name: Ebglyss
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 7 days, and up to 104°F for 4 hours
storage: Store refrigerated at 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F). Can be stored at room temperature up to 30°C (86°F) for up to 7 days. Protect from light. Do not freeze.
derivation: 86°F for 7 days (Storage); up to 104°F for 4 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Emgality
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 7 days, and up to 95°F for 4 days
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (86F) for up to 7 days. Discard pen/syringe if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 7 days. Do not place back in the refrigerator once it reachs room temperature. Do not freeze. Discard pen/syringe if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Do not shake.
derivation: 86°F for 7 days, do not place back in the fridge (Storage); up to 95°F for 4 days (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Enbrel (all formulations)
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for 30 days, and up to 107.6°F for 4 days
storage: Store in fridge 36-46*F. May be stored at room temp (up to 77*F) for up to 30 days. Do NOT return to fridge after it reaches room temp.

tiers.note: return it to the fridge, and use it within 4 days

flag: The sheet gives 30 days for all formulations. Amgen gives 30 days for the prefilled syringe and SureClick, but 14 days for the multi-dose vial and dose tray. Confirm which formulation shipped before relying on 30 days.
derivation: Storage gives 77°F for 30 days (do not return to the fridge). Excursion Length gives unopened product up to 107.6°F for 4 days, returned to the fridge and used within 4 days.

name: Evenity
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for 30 days, and up to 86°F for 5 days
storage: Refrigerate at 36°F to 46°F. Protect from light. Do not freeze. Do not shake. If removed from the refrigerator, can be kept at room temperature up to 77°F but must be used within 30 days.
derivation: 30 days at 77°F, plus up to 86°F for 5 days (120 hours) in addition.

name: Fiasp FlexTouch cartridges
excursionNote: Penfill: up to 86°F for no more than 28 days total (open or unopen) PumpCart: up to 86°F for max 18 days (unopened) or 98.4F up to 4 days (open)
storage: Store unopened cartridges between 36° to 46°F in a refrigerator. Penfill catridges may be stored up to 86F for up to 28 days, but PumpCart cartridges may only be stored up to 86F for up to 18 days. Once opened, store Penfill only at room temperature (up to 86F) for up to 28 days, PumpCart may be stored up to 98.6F for up to 4 days. Do not refrigerate after initial use.
flag: Penfill allows 28 days, PumpCart 18 days (unopened). The shorter 18 days is used. Confirm which cartridge shipped.
derivation: Two cartridge types with different windows in one row; the shorter is used.

name: Fiasp vials & FlexTouch Pen
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Store unopened vials/pens between 36° to 46°F in a refrigerator. May be stored up to 86F for 28 days. Do not freeze. Protect from light. Once opened, may store in fridge or at room temperature (up to 86F) for 28 days.

name: Forteo
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for 36 hours, and up to 104°F for 4 hours
storage: Store at 36-46F. Protect from light. Do not freeze. Discard device if frozen or 28 days after first use, even if there is medication left. Additional travel info states product can stay up to 77*F for 36 hours (store in fridge upon arrival)
derivation: Previously "no excursions allowed". The sheet now gives travel data of up to 77°F for 36 hours (back in the fridge on arrival) and up to 104°F for 4 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Genotropin
excursionNote: Before reconstitution: May be stored at 77°F for 14 days without loss of quality After reconstitution: may be stored at 77°F for 2 hours (per day for full 28 day duration of product) without loss of quality
storage: Store powder at 36-46F in original container until expiration date on box. Do Not Freeze. Store reconstituted genotropin in refrigerator (36-46F) for 28 days. Store in box with cap on to protect from light. Do not shake. Discard any unused medication after 28 days. Do not freeze.
derivation: Before reconstitution: 77°F for 14 days. (Previously "no excursions allowed".)

name: Humalog/Humulin
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 28 days, and up to 104°F for 12 hours
storage: Store at 36—46*F. May store at 86*F or less for up to 28 days before and after opening. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 86*F. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Discard pen 28 days after first use. Do not put pen back in the refrigerator after first use.
derivation: 86°F for 28 days before and after opening (Storage); up to 104°F for 12 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Humatrope
excursionNote: Temporary excursions allowed up to 104°F for up to 12 hours
storage: Before reconstituion, vials and cartridges are stable when refrigerated at 36° to 46°F. After reconstitution with provided diluent, vials are stable when refrigerated at 36° to 46°F for up to 14 days, and cartridges up to 28 days. Avoid freezing either one.
derivation: No room-temperature allowance in Storage, so the only window is the TempEx figure: up to 104°F for 12 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool). Judged against elapsed hours.

name: Humira
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 14 days
storage: Store in fridge 36-46*F. If traveling, may be stored at room temp (up to 77*F) for up to 14 days. Do not freeze. Protect from light.

name: Lantus
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Unopened vials and pens should be refrigerated at 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C) until expiration date OR at room temperature (up to 77F) for 28 days. Protect from light. Do not freeze. Opened vials can be stored at either room temperature or in the fridge for 28 days. Opened pens should only be stored at room temperature for 28 days.

name: Levemir
excursionNote: If unopened, can be stored at room temperature (up to 86°F) 42 days. If opened, vials can stay at room temp or in the fridge for up to 42 days, but pens must stay at room temperature.
storage: Store unused (unopened) in the refrigerator between 36° to 46°F (2° and 8°C). Do not store in the freezer or directly adjacent to the refrigerator cooling element. Do not freeze. Protect from light. If unopened, can be stored at room temperature (up to 86°F) 42 days. If opened, vials can stay at room temp or in the fridge for up to 42 days, but pens must stay at room temperature.

name: Lyumjev
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 28 days, and up to 104°F for 1 days
storage: Store at 36—46*F. May store at 86*F or less for up to 28 days before and after opening. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 86*F. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Discard pen 28 days after first use. Do not put pen back in the refrigerator after first use.
derivation: 86°F for 28 days (Storage); up to 104°F for 24 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Monovisc
excursionNote: Must be stored at no more than 77°F, no excursions allowed
storage: From CP (no prescribing information available unless you are administering): Store below 77F in original box until time of use. Do not save unused portion. Do not freeze.
derivation: Room-temperature product, stored below 77°F. "No excursions" means never above 77°F.

name: Mounjaro
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 21 days, and up to 104°F for 1 days
storage: May store up to 21 days at room temp (may go in and out of fridge -- cumulative 21 days)
derivation: 21 days at room temperature, cumulative (Storage; the 86°F ceiling is carried over because Storage names no temperature); up to 104°F for 24 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Nivestym
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 24 hours
storage: Store in the refrigerator (36-46F) in the original carton to protect from light. Discard any vial or prefilled syringe that has been at room temperature for more than 24 hours. Avoid freezing, discard if frozen more than once.

name: Norditropin
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 21 days
storage: Store at 36-46F. Do not store near the refrigerator cooling element. Do not freeze. Avoid direct light. After first use, pens may be stored in the refrigerator for 4 weeks or at room temperature (up to 77F) for 3 weeks.
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: "After first use, pens may be stored ... at room temperature (up to 77F) for 3 weeks."

name: Novolin (N and R)
excursionNote: Novolin N vials: at room temp below 77°F for 42 days Novolin N pens: at room temp below 86°F for 28 days Novolin R vials: at room temp below 77°F for 42 days
storage: Novolin N: Do not freeze. Protect from light. Unopened vials can be stored in fridge between 36° to 46°F (2° and 8°C) until expiration date or at room temp (below 77F) for 42 days. Unopened pens can be stored in the fridge or at room temp (below 86F) for 28 days. Once opened, vials and pens must remain at room temp (vials for 42 days, pens for 28 days) Novolin R: stored in fridge between 36° to 46°F until expiration date or at room temp (below 77°F) for 42 days. Do not refrigerate after first use.
flag: Presentation matters: N and R vials allow 77°F for 42 days, N pens 86°F for 28 days. The strictest of each (77°F, 28 days) is used. Confirm which presentation shipped.
derivation: Three presentations with different windows in one row; strictest ceiling and duration used.

name: Novolog Flexpen and Penfill catridges
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Store at 36° to 46°F. May store at 86*F or less for up to 28 days before and after opening. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 86*F. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Discard pen 28 days after first use. Do not put pen back in the refrigerator after first use.

name: Novolog Mix 70/30 Pen
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 14 days
storage: Store at 36° to 46°F. May store at room temperature (86*F or less) for up to 14 days before and after opening. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 86*F. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Discard pen 14 days after first use. Do not put pen back in the refrigerator after first use.

name: Novolog vials
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Store at 36° to 46°F. May store at 86*F or less for up to 28 days before and after opening. After removal from refrigerator, do not store product above 86*F. Do not freeze. Once open, may store in fridge or room temperature for 28 days. Discard vial 28 days after first use.

name: Omnitrope
excursionNote: No excursions allowed
storage: Before use, store at 36-46F in the original carton to protect from light. After first use, store cartridges in the refrigerator for up to 28 days. Reconstituted vials may be stored in the refrigerator for up to 21 days after reconstitution.

name: Opzelura
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 28 days, and up to 104°F for 20 days, and up to 59°F for 4 days
storage: STORE AT ROOM TEMPERATURE AT 68-77*F. MAY BE STORED AT 59-86*F FOR UP TO 28 DAYS. MAY BE STORED AT 86-104*F FOR UP TO 20 DAYS. MAY BE STORED AT -4-59*F FOR UP TO 4 DAYS
derivation: Room-temperature cream with three banded allowances. The 59-86°F band is the everyday one.

name: Orencia
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 15 days
storage: Store in the refrigerator (36-46F) in the original carton to protect from light. Do not freeze. Should warm up to room temperature (max 77F) before use, but cannot go back in the fridge once it has. Excursions allowed up to 77*F for 15 days if protected from light.

name: Orthovisc
excursionNote: Must be stored at no more than 77°F, no excursions allowed
storage: From CP (no prescribing information available unless you are administering): Store below 77F in original box until time of use. Do not save unused portion. Do not freeze.
derivation: Room-temperature product, stored below 77°F. "No excursions" means never above 77°F.

name: Otezla
excursionNote: Up to 104°F for 30 days
storage: IR Tablets: Store below 86°F. Excursions permitted up to 104°F for no more than 30 days. Return to recommended storage conditions within 30 days. ER tablets: Store between 68°F and 77°F. Excursions permitted between 59°F and up to 104°F for no more than 180 days before return to recommended storage conditions.
derivation: Tablets. IR: store below 86°F, excursions to 104°F for up to 30 days. ER allows 180 days; the shorter IR figure is used since the row covers both.

name: Ozempic
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 56 days
storage: Store in fridge at 36° to 46°F. Once opened, can be stored in fridge or at room temp up to 56 days. Do not freeze. Protect from light.
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: "Once opened, can be stored in fridge or at room temp up to 56 days."

name: Praluent
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 30 days
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (77F) for up to 30 days. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used with 30 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Protect from light. Do not shake.

name: Prolia
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for 30 days, and up to 104°F for 7 days
storage: Store in a refrigerator at 36°F to 46°F. Do not freeze. Prior to administration, Prolia may be allowed to reach room temperature (up to 77°F) and must be used within 30 days.

tiers.note: return it to the fridge; it keeps to its expiration date

derivation: Storage: may reach room temperature (77°F) and must be used within 30 days. Excursion: up to 104°F for 7 days, returned to storage.

name: Repatha
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for 30 days, and up to 104°F for 3 days
storage: Store in a refrigerator at 36°F to 46°F. Do not freeze. Prior to administration, Prolia may be allowed to reach room temperature (up to 77°F) and must be used within 30 days.

tiers.note: do not return it to the fridge

flag: The Storage cell on this row is Prolia's text (it names Prolia). The 77°F / 30-day room temperature window is carried over from the previous sheet. Confirm against the label.
derivation: Excursion: up to 104°F for 3 days, do not return to the fridge. Primary window carried over because the Storage cell was copied from Prolia.

name: Retacrit
excursionNote: Stable for up to 30 days at 77°F (single dose vial formulation only)
storage: Store at 36°F to 46°F (2°C to 8°C). Do not freeze. Protect from light.
flag: The 30 days at 77°F applies to the single-dose vial only. Confirm the presentation.
derivation: Excursion Length limits the allowance to the single-dose vial.

name: Saxenda
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 30 days
storage: Store in fridge at 36° to 46°F. Do not freeze. After initial use, the pen can be stored for 30 days at controlled room temperature (59° to 86°F) or in a refrigerator (36° to 46°F)
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: "After initial use, the pen can be stored for 30 days."

name: Simponi (PF pen & Aria)
excursionNote: Up to 77F for a maximum single period of 30 days. Once stored at room temperature, do not return to refrigerator.
storage: Refrigerate at 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC). Do not freeze. Protect from light. If needed, may be stored up to 77F for a maximum single period of 30 days. Once stored at room temperature, do not return to refrigerator.

name: Skyrizi
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 48 hours. Medication can be placed back in refrigerator and stored if the 48 hours has not expired
storage: Store in the refrigerator (36-46F). Protect from light. Do not shake. Do not freeze.
derivation: Up to 86°F for 48 hours; may go back in the fridge if the 48 hours has not expired.

name: Sogroya
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 72 hours total (may go back into fridge)
storage: Store in a refrigerator at 36°F to 46°F with the cap on and in the original carton to protect from light. Do not freeze. Discard if pen has been kept above 86°F. May be stored at room temperature (up to 77°F) for up to 72 hours total excursion time (may be placed back in the refrigerator.) Must be discarded 6 weeks after first use if refrigerated while not in use, or in 72 hours if kept at room temperature.
derivation: Up to 77°F for 72 hours total excursion time, may be placed back in the fridge. The sheet now states this as an excursion allowance, not only as an after-first-use discard rule.

name: Soliqua
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Prior to first use, pen should be stored in a refrigerator, 36°F-46°F (2°C-8°C). Do not freeze. Protect from light. After first use, store at room temperature up to 77°F (25°C). Discard pen 28 days after first use.
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: refrigerate before first use; room temperature only after first use.

name: Stelara
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 30 days
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (86F) for up to 30 days. Do not return to refrigerator after reaching room temperature. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used within 30 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Do not shake.

name: Taltz
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 5 days, and up to 104°F for 8 hours
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (86F) for up to 5 days. Do not return to refrigerator after reaching room temperature. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used within 5 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light. Do not shake.
derivation: 86°F for 5 days, do not return to the fridge (Storage); up to 104°F for 8 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool). Settles the old 77°F vs 86°F conflict in favour of the label's 86°F.

name: Toujeo
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 56 days
storage: Unopened pens (Solostar and MAX Solostar) should be refrigerated at 36°F-46°F (2°C-8°C) until expiration date. Once opened, do not refrigerate, but store at room temperature (up to 86F) for 56 days. Do not freeze. Protect from light.
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: unopened pens refrigerated until expiration; 56 days only once opened.

name: Tremfya
excursionNote: Up to 77F for no more than 4 hours for administration or for up to 24 hours for delivery and transportation.
storage: Refrigerate at 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC). Do not freeze. Protect from light. May be exposed one time only to temperatures not exceeding 77F for no more than 4 hours in preparation for administration. During delivery/transportation, may be exposed up to 77F for up to 24 hours.
derivation: Up to 77°F for 4 hours in preparation for administration, or for up to 24 hours during delivery and transportation. Transit is what this tool checks, so 24 hours. The Max Temp cell (86°F) is not the excursion limit.

name: Tresiba (vials and FlexTouch)
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 56 days
storage: Store in fridge at 36ºF to 46ºF. Do not freeze. Can be stored at room temp <86* for up to 56 days. Once opened, may be stored in fridge or at room temp up to 86*F for up to 56 days.

name: Trulicity
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 14 days, and up to 104°F for 14 hours
storage: Store in fridge (may be stored at room temp up to 14 days -- can go in and out multiple times as long as total combined length out of fridge is not > 14 days
derivation: 14 days total out of the fridge, in and out allowed (Storage; 86°F carried over because Storage names no temperature); up to 104°F for 14 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).

name: Victoza
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 30 days
storage: Store in fridge. After initial use, the pen can be stored for 30 days at controlled room temperature (59 - 86*F) or in a refrigerator (36 - 46*F)
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: "After initial use, the pen can be stored for 30 days."

name: Wegovy
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 28 days
storage: Store in fridge. May be stored at room temp (46-86*F) up to 28 days.

name: Xultophy
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for no more than 21 days
storage: Store in fridge. After the first use, the pen can be stored for 21 days at a controlled room temperature of 59 - 86*F or in a fridge 36 - 46*F
flag: The room-temperature figure in the sheet applies after first use. The sheet gives no allowance for an unopened pen in transit. Check the label or the manufacturer before relying on it.
derivation: Storage: "After the first use, the pen can be stored for 21 days."

name: Yusimry
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 14 days
storage: Store at 46-36F. May be stored at room temperature (77F) for up to14 days. Do not return to refrigerator after reaching room temperature. Discard pen if it has been stored at room temperature and not used within14 days. Do not freeze. Discard pen if it has been frozen, even if it has thawed. Store in original carton to protect from light.

name: Zarxio
excursionNote: Up to 77°F for no more than 8 days
storage: Store in the refrigerator (36-46F). Protect from light. Discard any vial or prefilled syringe that has been at room temperature (up to 77F) for more than 8 days. Do not freeze. Do not shake.

name: Zepbound
excursionNote: Up to 86°F for 21 days, and up to 104°F for 1 days
storage: Store in the refrigerator (36-46F). Protect from light. If needed, may be stored at room temperature (up to 86F) for up to a total 21 days. May be placed back in the refrigerator after reaching room temperature. Do not freeze.
derivation: 86°F for a total of 21 days, may go back in the fridge (Storage); up to 104°F for 24 hours (Lilly TempEx stability tool).
